parsed.why: De-facto criminalisation of gender nonconformity itself via morality offences (5 years), religious rulings against transition care, no protections or recognition, plus documented militia killings and torture of gender-nonconforming people; state bystander to extrajudicial violence.

No trans-specific criminalisation, no facility restriction, marriage equality, tolerant documented society, few organised opponents. Gender-identity gap in anti-discrimination law is resident-facing; hostile head-of-state remarks are dated and LGB-focused, leaving no documented visitor-facing exposure.

Police use the ambiguous morality provision as a documented pretext for extortion; NGO-recorded harassment and extortion by state and nonstate actors, no discrimination or hate-crime recourse, and severe measured social hostility — offset partly because reported violence is punished.

Gender identity covered by anti-discrimination and hate-speech law with one demonstrated bias conviction, but unremedied widespread hate speech, ineffective prosecution, hostile municipal officials and a decade-stale severe attitude record; no universal facility or border exposure documented.

Routine documented police detention and extortion of trans people, live sodomy statutes used as backdrop, and prison abuse including nonconsensual procedures found by courts — balanced by active courts granting relief, association rights and expanding protections.
